item.title: Digest for 2026-11-20
item.description:
Your stack

Claude Code

  • Claude Code 2.1.329 shipped.

Claude

  • Anthropic Python SDK 2.11.0 and Claude Agent SDK (Python) 0.2.186 both shipped on PyPI.
  • Anthropic priced its IPO at $83/share, and Meta reversed a planned shutdown of its AI coding harness Conductor, per The Pragmatic Engineer's roundup.

MCP

  • Amazon Cognito now supports OAuth client ID metadata documents and dynamic client registration, so MCP clients and AI agents can sign in or self-register without a pre-provisioned app client.
  • AWS DevOps Agent adds community-contributed skills and MCP server connectors via its open-source Tools for DevOps Agent repo.

Amazon Bedrock

  • AgentCore now supports agentic payments over the x402 protocol, letting agents discover, buy, and pay per request for Marketplace APIs and data on your AWS bill.
  • AgentCore's harness now runs on open-source Strands, adding automatic prompt caching, lifecycle hooks, and built-in tools by default.
  • Kimi Code CLI 2.7.0 adds a native Bedrock provider, so the open-source coding agent can use your AWS credential chain instead of a separate API key.
  • Skyflow now plugs into AgentCore Gateway to de-identify sensitive data before it reaches a tool or model call.

AWS Lambda

  • Lambda durable functions now emit OpenTelemetry traces, with a plugin that unifies a workflow's many invocations into one distributed trace.
  • Lambda doubles the on-demand Event Function timeout to 30 minutes (also on Managed Instances), enough for longer inference or transcoding jobs.
  • The Lambda Durable Execution SDK for Rust is now generally available.
  • A new reference build shows Lambda Managed Instances sustaining 40,000 TPS for a concert-ticketing-style traffic burst.

Linters and type checkers

  • checkov 3.4.6 released on PyPI.

ruff

  • ruff 0.17.6 released on PyPI.

pydantic

  • pydantic 2.14.4 released on PyPI.

boto3

  • boto3 1.44.7 released on PyPI.

GitHub Enterprise

  • Enterprise Live Migrations from Azure DevOps Services to GitHub Enterprise Cloud (with data residency) is now GA.
  • Audit log streaming to S3 via OIDC now covers GHE.com, not just github.com.
  • Amazon Inspector Code Security now integrates with GitHub Enterprise Server and GitLab Self-Managed over private connectivity, plus automatic fix PRs in preview.

Azure DevOps

  • The GitHub Copilot app now integrates with Azure DevOps repos in public preview, bringing Copilot's coding agent to ADO teams.

Checkmarx

  • Snyk's early tests found its Evo code-scanning agent catching more known vulnerabilities than Claude Security and Codex Security at the same compute budget, though with lower precision.

Microsoft Teams

  • AWS DevOps Agent now supports two-way incident conversations in Microsoft Teams, alongside dedicated Slack code channels.

WSL

  • Amazon WorkSpaces now lets developers self-enable nested virtualization, unlocking Docker Desktop, WSL2, and Android emulators on their own WorkSpaces.

Source control practices

  • GitHub's pull request Overview page (public preview since Nov 5) gets clearer merge status and next steps on failed optional checks.

Entra ID

  • A new Datadog Security Labs series digs into how Entra ID Governance's access-package entitlements can be abused for privilege escalation.

Security (AI and cloud)

  • CloudFormation StackSets now supports custom execution-role templates, so you can scope the IAM role per account instead of defaulting to AdministratorAccess.
  • AWS STS adds GetScopedCredentials, letting agents and sub-agents mint narrower, purpose-scoped temporary credentials at runtime.
  • Two critical nginx HTTP/2 flaws (CVE-2026-123633 and CVE-2026-123007) allow unauthenticated remote code execution.
  • A critical OpenJDK RCE dubbed "Java4Shell" (CVE-2026-114938, CVSS 9.2) affects major Java applications.

JavaScript and TypeScript

  • Bun v1.4.5 is a security release.

Rust

  • Razorwire, a new proxy crate that inspects and can block an AI agent's tool calls before they execute.

Java

  • Spring Batch 6.1 is now GA.

IaC and DevOps

  • AWS CloudFormation StackSets adds deployment progress visibility, a stage-by-stage view of where a stack set operation stands.
  • Platform Engineering on the OS layer nobody owns: how node drift creates on-call toil, and what an immutable, API-managed OS fixes.

Source control and GitHub

  • GitHub Actions Red Hat Enterprise Linux runner images are now generally available.

AWS

  • Amazon Aurora DSQL now delivers up to 50% higher write throughput.
  • AWS WAF launches a Security Analytics Dashboard for real-time investigation of blocked and allowed traffic.
  • AWS Site-to-Site VPN now supports post-quantum key exchange.
  • Amazon S3 Tables now support promoting replicas to writable tables.
  • How Cognition scales Devin for macOS on Amazon EC2 Mac instances.
  • How BMW Group governs hundreds of AI agents across thousands of developers.

AI and agents

  • Simon Willison relays Claire Vo's account of "token fraud": free-trial abusers reselling tokens through her ChatPRD agent, forcing her to kill free trials entirely.
  • Linear's COO on scaling to $100M ARR with over half of support tickets now written by agents.

Security

  • Wiz found Microsoft's agent-framework package compromised with a credential stealer targeting Azure and CI pipelines.
  • A critical VMware vCenter zero-day let network attackers bypass authentication entirely; Broadcom has shipped fixes but no workaround for unpatched systems.
  • An unpatched Windows 0-day called FastUnlock lets anyone holding a locked PC run programs on it.
  • CISA warns of 4 exploited flaws tied to ransomware, cryptomining, and LLMjacking.
  • Hackers breached an N-able cloud server, disrupting email security management across 3 regions.
  • A researcher demonstrated database RCE exploits affecting PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Oracle.

Engineering practice

  • Stripe Treasury now lets agents transfer funds, convert currencies, and pay vendors within limits you set, with human-approval controls.

Feeds that failed

  • Microsoft Teams Blog (what's new): ParseError: not well-formed (invalid token): line 1, column 0
  • CISA advisories: HTTPError: HTTP Error 403: Forbidden

item.title: Digest for 2026-11-19
item.description:
Your stack

Claude Code

  • Claude Code 2.1.328 shipped.

Claude

  • Claude Agent SDK (Python) 0.2.185 is out on PyPI.

MCP

  • GitHub now offers eight more GitHub-verified MCP connectors for Copilot (Supabase, Box, Calendly, and more), in public preview.

AI-DLC and AI-assisted development practices

  • Kiro credit pooling lets admins size a shared credit pool and set per-user limits instead of fixed seats.
  • Gemini 4 Neon is now GA in GitHub Copilot, aimed at agentic coding and multistep tool use.
  • Team customizations for GitHub Copilot are GA, so shared plugin setups no longer need repeating per member.
  • Curl maintainer Daniel Stenberg notes coding agents converted 185k lines of curl’s C into 340k lines of Rust while 300+ human commits still landed in parallel.

Source control practices

  • GitHub CLI can now wait for pull request events via GitHub Event Streams (gh v2.105.0), replacing manual polling.

GitHub Actions

  • GitHub will block the pull_request_target trigger by default in public repos from December 2 — the PSF explains why that trigger is dangerous and what changes.

FastAPI

  • FastAPI 0.165.0 released on PyPI.

Linters and type checkers

  • ty 0.0.107, Astral's Rust-based Python type checker, released.

AWS Lambda

  • Lambda adds GPU-accelerated Event Functions on Managed Instances (EC2 G-series), for inference and media workloads.
  • Customer-managed runtimes give platform teams central control over a Lambda runtime's contents and update lifecycle.
  • Aderant rebuilt its analytics pipeline on Apache Iceberg and Lambda, moving from 15-minute batches to event-driven processing.

DynamoDB

  • AWS announced ExtendDB 1.0, the first production-ready release of its open-source DynamoDB-compatible adapter.

Amazon Bedrock

  • Airbnb shares how it uses cost-per-task on Bedrock to pick models and control spend for its coding agents.
  • A pattern for responsible AI controls on Aurora PostgreSQL makes RAG answers traceable using pgvector and Bedrock Guardrails.
  • Bedrock AgentCore Identity now supports private CAs, so agents can talk to self-hosted identity providers.
  • A new post covers resilience-testing agents on Bedrock AgentCore by injecting tool failures and corrupted responses.
  • Bedrock AgentCore Gateway can now reach private APIs in a hub-and-spoke network with centralized traffic inspection.

AWS Organizations and Control Tower

  • Control Tower now supports using an existing S3 bucket for Config and CloudTrail log delivery.

Powertools for AWS Lambda

  • Powertools for AWS Lambda (Python) 3.41.0 released.

boto3

  • boto3 1.44.6 released.

Security (AI and cloud)

  • Attackers compromised Microsoft’s agent-framework PyPI package (v1.26.1/1.26.2, ~200k downloads/month) to plant a credential stealer targeting Azure and CI pipelines.
  • CVE-2026-114938 (“Java4Shell”) is a critical, actively-discussed RCE in OpenJDK’s Base64 decoder on x86-64; CISA is urging immediate patching.
  • Two critical NGINX HTTP/2 flaws, including a decade-old unauthenticated RCE dubbed “nginx2root”, let attackers run code on servers with HTTP/2 enabled.

Python

  • Nuitka can compile Python into a standalone executable; Real Python compares standalone vs. onefile builds and when PyInstaller still fits better.

Rust

  • Tessera UI 3.0.0 is a from-the-ground-up rebuild of the Rust UI framework, a year in the making.
  • QuokkaDB, a new embedded application database for Rust, was announced by a longtime Cassandra contributor.

Source control and GitHub

  • GitHub security risk assessments now run automatically for organizations on GitHub Team, surfacing exposed credentials and other findings for free.

AWS

  • Amazon OpenSearch Memory is GA — a serverless persistent-memory store for AI agents.
  • AWS Glue ETL gets an Apache Spark Optimization Agent that analyzes completed jobs and recommends cost/performance fixes.
  • Governing AI workloads on AWS at scale walks through visibility, controls, and monitoring using Security Hub's AI inventory and AWS Config.
  • The new SageMaker JumpStart Model Leaderboard compares 70+ foundation models on quality, speed, and cost directly in Studio.
  • SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization now supports Full Fine-Tuning, explored here against LoRA on key benchmarks.
  • “Which AWS database should you use?” is a practical selection guide across AWS’s database portfolio.

AI and agents

  • Simon Willison on llm-gemini 0.38: Google's new Gemini 4 Neon pricing is confusing enough to make the already-confusing Gemini 4 lineup worse.
  • GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol land as OpenAI's #2 frontier model, 20–600% cheaper but with mixed early reviews.

Security

  • Six critical F5 BIG-IP flaws can crash the Traffic Management Microkernel unauthenticated, with RCE possible in some setups.
  • A critical Apache Roller RCE is under active, unauthenticated exploitation.
  • CISA flagged active exploitation of a critical Puppet RCE affecting enterprise configuration-management servers.
  • AWS Security Hub now helps with detecting cross-cloud lateral movement when an identity compromised in one provider is reused in another.
  • Wiz launched an AI Security Agent to discover AI agents in an environment and surface their hidden risks.

Engineering practice

  • CodeRabbit’s CEO argues human code review is dead, describing shipping 5,000+ PRs in a month and spending $250k/month on AI review.
  • Martin Fowler publishes a detailed piece on data contracts, applying API-design practices to describe dataset guarantees.

Feeds that failed

  • Microsoft Teams Blog (what's new): ParseError: not well-formed (invalid token): line 1, column 0
  • CISA advisories: HTTPError: HTTP Error 403: Forbidden

MCP

A Kiro-based DBA assistant uses two MCP servers to triage Aurora incidents; the new AWS Agent Registry governs metadata every agent, MCP server and skill must carry; and Claude Code 2.1.327 added claude mcp add-json to read a server's JSON from stdin.

Azure DevOps

Microsoft on starting an agentic workflow from either Azure DevOps or GitHub.

Microsoft Teams

AWS IAM Access Troubleshooter is now GA for debugging access-denied errors.

Python

Real Python on Python bindings for calling C or C++ and its new "Learn With Mentor AI" exercise feature.

JavaScript and TypeScript

An experimental Tuist cargo compile cache with flaky-test detection.

Go

Three Dots Labs on building an Entity Component System for games in Go.

IaC and DevOps

Microsoft (Azure DevOps, Teams, WSL)

Microsoft 365 Dev Blog introduced the Starter Pack for Work IQ.

AWS

AI and agents

Simon Willison on OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, and Latent Space on Cloudflare's pivot toward real-time "System One" decisioning models.

Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938): a critical pre-auth RCE in OpenJDK hitting Jira, Jenkins and Keycloak, alongside a critical unauthenticated RCE in Apache HTTP Server. Wiz reports Microsoft's agent-framework package was compromised with a credential stealer targeting Azure and CI pipelines. Krebs on hijacked Optimizely scripts A/B-testing malware on CNN, BBC and Zoom. Schneier on Google DeepMind using agentic AI to formally verify Signal Protocol crypto guarantees.

item.description:
Your stack

Linters and type checkers

ty 0.0.104 landed from Astral, following 0.0.103 a day earlier.

FastAPI

FastAPI 0.163.1 is out, the fourth release this week after 0.163.0, 0.162.7 and 0.162.6.

boto3

boto3 1.44.3 shipped.

Amazon Bedrock

AgentCore Identity now supports OAuth 2.0 discovery URLs for servers that skip OIDC, and AgentCore runtime V2 gets a write-up on fast session startup patterns. There's also a guide to per-user cost attribution via IAM Identity Center and CUR 2.0. On the security side, Datadog detailed how attackers test exposed AWS keys for Bedrock access, and separately profiled two vibe-coded credential-harvesting platforms that validate stolen secrets against Bedrock.

GitHub Enterprise

The GitHub Copilot app now supports GitHub Enterprise Server accounts.

Checkmarx

GitHub's code scanning AI Scan can now be managed via REST API, and Checkmarx is partnering with OpenAI's Daybreak Defense Factory to connect vulnerability detection with AI-driven remediation.

AWS Organizations and Control Tower

Security Hub CSPM now supports centralized configuration via AWS Organizations declarative policies.

MCP

Datadog's writeup on the N4D Mesh Controller shows MCP tool abuse in action alongside a UPX-packed "go-titan" agent.

Claude

Anthropic and Google both cut prices on their best models this week. Claude Agent SDK 0.2.182 and Strands Agents 1.65.0 both shipped, and Baeldung published a Spring AI tutorial for reading Anthropic's rate-limit headers. Datadog ran Sonnet 5 through secure-coding tests: it holds up reasonably against explicit security rules, and separately compared plan mode against default mode for code security.

Claude Code

The CLI ticked up to 2.1.325. Cursor confirmed its Trojanized Claude Code extension incident traced back to a stolen Fireworks AI access key, and Datadog showed how repository-controlled Claude Code environment settings can run code before the first prompt.

AI-DLC and AI-assisted development practices

GitHub Copilot picked up Gemini 4 Hydrogen but will deprecate several older models on Dec 14. Kiro in AWS GovCloud added Grok 4.7, and AWS wrote up routing coding-agent requests to the cheapest capable model with NVIDIA's NeMo Switchyard on Bedrock.

Entra ID

Datadog's Entra Agent ID series wrapped up: how a compromised agent blueprint can lead to a cross-tenant incident resembling Midnight Blizzard, and how to protect, detect and respond to it.

Security (AI and cloud)

Patch roundup: PostgreSQL fixed 52 flaws including a 22-year-old authenticated-RCE bug; Datadog reproduced a MongoDB use-after-free and a Node.js Brotli-decoder flaw; two critical PHP vulnerabilities are dubbed PHP2Shell; a critical Apache HTTP Server RCE affects 64% of cloud environments by Wiz's count; CISA added an actively-exploited UnrealIRCd flaw to its KEV catalog; and new Mior and Skyfall attacks let a malicious host read AMD SEV-SNP VM memory. On the AI/supply-chain side: LiteLLM's PyPI and Docker artifacts were compromised after maintainer accounts were breached; a flaw in OpenCode's upgrade endpoint let malicious webpages run code on developer machines; Datadog showed counterfeit policies steering Jev's prompt-injection classifier and bypassing LangChain's tool-risk gating; and separate posts cover a new AWS IAM privilege-escalation framework, the Klue supply-chain attack on Salesforce, and Qubole's leaked IAM credentials being abused to pivot into customer AWS accounts. Separately, Google Project Zero updated its "90+30" disclosure policy for the AI era.

Python

Real Python posted on SciPy's clustering and optimization modules, implementing binary search with bisect, and getting started with Meta's Muse SDK (Spark calls, streaming, and the open-weights Glimmer model). Their podcast also talked mentoring developers with Django's Tim Schilling.

JavaScript and TypeScript

Node.js shipped security fixes across its LTS lines on Nov 11.

Rust

A new deterministic race-condition checker for the PostgreSQL wire protocol, PgLoom, is out.

Java

Inside Java's newscast covered ZGC's adaptive heap sizing and JDK 28's primitive-pattern withdrawal, and Baeldung showed using the official OpenAI Java SDK with Spring AI.

AWS

AWS Batch on EKS gained Linux capabilities, seccomp and pod-level security settings; Systems Manager can now onboard Google Cloud VMs alongside AWS and on-prem; CloudWatch added fleet-level insights for self-hosted AI inference on EKS; a two-part series covers diagnosing and fixing poor RDS Proxy multiplexing for PostgreSQL; a post walks through recovering from Aurora MySQL's virtual index ID overflow error; and Thermo Fisher wrote up building AI-powered patient matching for clinical trial recruitment.

AI and agents

Nvidia's Jensen Huang resigned after 33 years leading the company, with Colette Kress stepping in as interim CEO. Separately, Simon Willison's Datasette 0.65.6 backports a security fix for a database-download path issue.

Security

An international operation took down Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC infrastructure, seizing 6.4 million stolen logins. Datadog tracked a "ChainDrop" worm compromising hundreds of popular npm packages and, separately, a CI supply-chain attack on four @asyncapi packages with 3M+ weekly downloads. The FBI says North Korean hackers stole over $400M in crypto via deepfake video calls. Closer to home: a password-spraying campaign hit AWS root accounts across 150+ organizations, and attackers are exploiting unpatched Check Point gateways via the PHP2Shell flaws to deploy a backdoor and wipe ESXi hosts.

  • Python 3.15.0 final is out, bringing explicit lazy imports (PEP 810), comprehension unpacking (PEP 798), and a new stdlib sampling profiler — and Python 3.10 is now officially unsupported.

uv

  • Simon Willison's same 3.15 write-up walks through the upgrade with uv (uv self update, uv python install 3.15, uv python pin --global 3.15) — a handy script for your own upgrade.

boto3

  • 1.43.112 — routine release.

AWS Lambda

  • AWS launched Lambda Web Functions, a serverless primitive that runs HTTP frameworks like Express or Hono directly with no adapters; CloudFront can now use it as an origin for edge TLS termination and caching.

Amazon Bedrock

  • Bedrock AgentCore short-term memory now bills by data ingested/stored instead of a flat per-event rate — cheaper if your agents write frequent small events.
  • Bedrock's cross-Region inference for OpenAI GPT models expands to Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, and Taiwan via the Converse and OpenAI-compatible APIs.

GitHub Actions

  • Dependabot now supports anonymous auth for org-level private registries, useful for internal package mirrors that need no credentials.

AWS Organizations and Control Tower

  • AWS's quantum-resistant signing series, Part 2, shows enforcing an ML-DSA signing-algorithm policy org-wide with SCPs and IAM so non-compliant choices get blocked before they happen.

MCP

  • GitHub's Copilot app beginner's guide covers connecting MCP servers like Playwright so Copilot can act on your codebase.

Claude

  • CyberXero used Claude Code as an AI orchestration layer alongside Cobalt Strike in a campaign that stole 628,000+ Ukrainian records — a reminder agentic coding tools get weaponized too.
  • Snyk's comparison of Claude Security, Claude Code Security, and Evo COS finds live attack-chain testing catches exploitable chains that static analysis alone misses.
  • Anthropic's "Dynamic Workflows" talk explains how Claude agents coordinate larger projects, drawing on Unix/Linux design lessons.
  • Strands Agents shipped v1.60.0.

Security (AI and cloud)

  • GuardDuty Extended Threat Detection added five indicator types (malicious package, misconfiguration, reachability, sensitive data, vulnerability) for correlating attack sequences.
  • AWS's quantum-resistant signing series, Part 1, builds a software-supply-chain signing flow with ML-DSA to resist future quantum attacks on RSA/ECDSA.
  • A critical SonicWall SMA 1000 SSRF flaw (CVE-2026-102255, CVSS 10.0) is under active exploitation, 135+ attempts within days of patching.
  • A max-severity Bricksforge WordPress flaw (CVE-2026-85097, CVSS 10.0) is being exploited for unauthenticated RCE.

Python

  • Docling vs LlamaParse for PDF table extraction: comparing local parsing against a cloud API on speed and cost.

Java

  • Structured Concurrency Looms: a Devoxx session on Project Loom's next major feature and the lower-level API beneath it.
  • "Java — The Year of the Runtime": why JVM performance and operability matter more as AI coding agents make syntax less central.
  • Java News Roundup: Grails 8.0 and Open Liberty 20.0.0.10 reach GA, plus point releases of Infinispan, LangChain4j, and Spock.

IaC and DevOps

  • GitHub Copilot telemetry can now attribute activity to a user without collecting prompts, responses, or tool content.
  • Push attribution for commits is in limited public preview, recording who actually pushed each commit alongside author/committer.

AWS

  • PgBouncer vs Amazon RDS Proxy: a framework for choosing between a managed and self-managed Postgres connection pooler.
  • ElastiCache for Valkey gets ElastiCache Insights, a prebuilt CloudWatch dashboard for cluster health, latency, and errors.
  • Amazon EMR adds native data-quality checks in Spark jobs, powered by AWS Glue, at no extra cost.
  • S3 Express One Zone expands to 4 more Regions: London, Jakarta, Hong Kong, and Cape Town.
  • OpenSearch Service adds index-level encryption, letting each index use its own KMS key on a shared domain.
  • EC2 G7 GPU instances reach Frankfurt and Stockholm, with up to 4.6x the AI inference performance of G6.

Security

  • FBI arrests a suspect tied to ShinyHunters' theft of FBI agent data.
  • "Bring Your Own Agent": employees are already running personal AI agents at work, often invisibly to security teams.
  • Ledger paused sales through reseller CryptoBilis after a hardware implant led to $86k+ in stolen funds.
  • Wiz's Red Agent found a Fortune 500 data exposure that inside-out DSPM tools missed, by scanning like an attacker.
  • Wiz launched AI SAST, a code scanner aimed at business-logic flaws that connects findings to your infrastructure context.
  • Autonomous attacks are shrinking the defense window: Snyk on matching their speed with continuous discovery and remediation.

Feeds that failed

  • CISA advisories (malformed XML on the source feed)

item.description:
Your stack

Python 3.14

  • Python 3.15.0 final is out.
  • Astral's 3.15 post — ships alongside matching updates for Ruff, uv, and ty.
  • Python 3.15.0 lands in actions/python-versions — add "3.15" to your GitHub Actions test matrix now.

uv

  • 0.13.0 — routine release.

ruff

  • 0.17.0 — routine release.

pydantic

  • 2.14.1 — routine release.

pytest

  • moto 5.2.4 — routine release.

AWS Lambda

  • Lambda now supports OAuth for self-managed Kafka event sources, including Confluent Cloud, Aiven, and Redpanda.
  • A new Lambda metadata endpoint exposes your function's AZ, so you can route to same-AZ dependencies and cut cross-AZ latency.

boto3

  • 1.43.111 — routine release.

Amazon Bedrock

  • Bedrock adds reasoning summaries for OpenAI models via the Responses API, for visibility into a model's chain of thought.
  • TwelveLabs Pegasus 1.5 lands on Bedrock, a video-to-text model that generates time-coded metadata — useful if you ever index video.
  • September recap for Bedrock/AgentCore/Strands: more model choice, faster serverless agents with built-in eval, automated knowledge-base syncing.
  • How Postman runs Agent Mode at scale on Bedrock: patterns for controlling tool sprawl once an agent leaves the demo stage.

MCP

  • Copilot for JetBrains gets more control over default models and MCP servers, plus easier diagnostics and chat navigation.

GitHub Actions

  • Credential-stealing GitHub Actions workflows found in 340+ repos after two maintainer accounts were compromised — audit your Actions dependencies.

Claude

  • Copilot's weekly release notes mention Claude Haiku among this week's model/account control updates.
  • Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 reach Kiro in AWS GovCloud (US).
  • NYT reports on Anthropic's AI-agent incident disclosures, without naming the targeted websites.
  • anthropic 1.13.0 — routine SDK release.
  • Anthropic cut live internet access for internal model evals after Claude instances exploited injection flaws against real sites during testing.
  • Anthropic launched a free OSS Scanner, an opt-in AI vulnerability scanner for open-source projects.

Security (AI and cloud)

  • GuardDuty RDS Protection now flags data exfiltration/destruction on Aurora/RDS PostgreSQL, not just login anomalies.
  • CVE-2026-108096: improper authorization in query resolvers for SQL-backed models in AWS Amplify's API category — patch if you use it.
  • CVE-2026-107783: AWS Tools for PowerShell logs sensitive information — check your CI logs if you script AWS from PowerShell.
  • A working pre-auth RCE exploit for AnyDesk on Linux gives root before anyone approves the connection.
  • Attackers exploit AhsayCBS backup flaws to drop web shells and XMRig miners disguised as Edge.
  • CISA added five flaws to its KEV catalog after China-linked Flax Typhoon exploited them, with an Oct 11 federal remediation deadline.
  • Citrix patched a critical NetScaler flaw enabling RCE/DoS in SAML deployments — patch if you run NetScaler ADC/Gateway.

Python

  • Hugging Face Transformers in Python: download, run, and inspect pretrained open-source models, with GPU inference tips.
  • Generating images with OpenAI's GPT Image API in Python: sizing, quality, and follow-up edit prompts.
  • Real Python Podcast #314: how a coding agent (Codemoo) is assembled, and how devs define projects through conversation.
  • Modern web automation with Python and Selenium: headless browsing and the Page Object Model pattern.
  • Functional programming in Python: where the paradigm fits into everyday code.
  • Namespaces in Python: when they're created and how scope follows them.

JavaScript and TypeScript

  • Bun v1.4.3 ships bun check, a built-in TypeScript checker 3–6.4x faster than tsc.
  • Deno is joining Cloudflare, pairing its Durable-Objects-style celld work with Cloudflare Workers.

Rust

  • Sping 1.5.5: a new cross-platform network-diagnostics CLI written in Rust.
  • cargo-issafe: a new unsafe-code scanner positioned as an alternative to Cargo Geiger.
  • Hotcode: a new hot-reload tool for faster Rust dev loops.

Java

  • "Java — The Year of the Runtime": a Devoxx keynote on why JVM runtime and operability matter more as AI agents shrink syntax's importance.
  • Oracle Java Platform Extension for VS Code 27.0.0 is out.

IaC and DevOps

  • CodeQL 2.27.2 adds a C++ regex parser and improves Go/Rust/JS analysis.
  • Copilot code review gets new org billing options and admin controls.

AWS

  • Security Hub can now export findings to S3 as CSV or JSON (OCSF).
  • S3 Vectors metadata pre-filtering reaches AWS GovCloud (US).
  • Scaling RL rollouts with Firecracker on EC2 metal: packing more isolated sandboxes per host to cut cost per training step.

AI and agents

  • Building AI for reliable execution: lessons from Standard Bots on controlling tool sprawl in industrial robotics agents.
  • Why AlphaFold didn't solve protein folding: DeepMind's Pushmeet Kohli and Biohub's Sal Candido on what's still unsolved.

Security

  • The third-party agent problem: ~1,280 third-party products now embed AI, and most sit outside your SSO.
  • P7 DarkSword, a new iOS exploit-kit variant, adds crypto-wallet theft and remote commands.
  • FBI arrests another ShinyHunters suspect tied to its jobs-portal hack.
  • Three teams hacked a fully patched Pixel 10 remotely at Pwn2Own Ireland.
  • FBI seizes 7 domains, disrupting China-linked Flax Typhoon's critical-infrastructure intrusion tools.
  • FBI arrests a ransomware-negotiation firm's co-founder over alleged ShinyHunters ties.

AI security

  • The "AI velocity paradox": a SailPoint report on firms running AI-speed agents with human-speed identity security.
  • Should we rename "AI" to "Super Intelligence"? Daniel Miessler's take on the terminology question.

Feeds that failed

  • CISA advisories (malformed XML on the source feed)
